title: TrainingRun
description: A run of one compiled artifact, with what § 6.1 says must be recorded to reproduce it. Source hash, compiler version, tensor shapes, compile flags (fast_math, deterministic) and backend are read through the artifact.

steps.description: TrainConfig.steps, the steps of this invocation counted from start_step, so the run ends at start_step + steps (DESIGN.md § 6).

checkpoint_every.description: TrainConfig.checkpoint_every, a positive step interval; absent means no periodic checkpoints (DESIGN.md § 6).

start_step.description: The step number the run started at; 0 unless it resumed from a checkpoint (DESIGN.md § 6.1 step number, § 9 gate 7).

current_step.description: The step number the run has reached; current_step <= start_step + steps, where the run ends (DESIGN.md § 6, step counter; § 6.1 step number). ESS cannot add two facts, so this bound is not an invariant.

resumed_from_checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint a resumed run loaded; start_step equals its step (DESIGN.md § 6.2, § 9 gate 7).

rng.description: The RNG state the run started from; rng.seed is the run's single seed (DESIGN.md § 6.1).

device_profile_id.description: Present exactly when the artifact's backend is Vulkan; a CPU run has no Vulkan device (DESIGN.md § 6.1 backend/device/driver). ESS cannot state the rule across the two entities.

modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.title: LearningRateSchedule
modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.description: How the learning rate varies over steps; a linear warmup over the first warmup_steps steps up to OptimizerConfig.learning_rate (epic:bert-from-scratch, AdamW with warmup).

modelspec.training.OptimizerConfig.title: OptimizerConfig
modelspec.training.OptimizerConfig.description: Optimizer hyperparameters, recorded for reproducibility (DESIGN.md § 6.1). The AdamW fields are present exactly when kind is AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, decoupled weight decay); its first and second moments are a checkpoint's optimizer slots (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

learning_rate.description: The base learning rate; the peak rate when a schedule is present.

schedule.description: Absent means a constant learning rate, as M0 SGD has.

x-ess-invariants: ((kind == Sgd and not (defined(weight_decay)) and not (defined(beta1)) and not (defined(beta2)) and not (defined(epsilon))) or (kind == AdamW and defined(weight_decay) and defined(beta1) and defined(beta2) and defined(epsilon)))

modelspec.training.OptimizerKind.title: OptimizerKind
modelspec.training.OptimizerKind.description: SGD from M0; AdamW with weight decay joins at M3 (DESIGN.md § 1, § 11 iteration 4; epic:bert-from-scratch). The CLI accepts only `sgd` until then.

modelspec.training.RngState.title: RngState
modelspec.training.RngState.description: RNG algorithm, seed and counter position (DESIGN.md § 2.3, § 6.1, § 6.2).
